## About this dashboard
The Controlled Drug Injections Presentation Report in ePACT2 provides a detailed breakdown of injectable controlled drugs by presentation, offering visibility into the specific formulations being prescribed and administered. This level of detail is essential for monitoring compliance with prescribing standards and ensuring that appropriate presentations are used for clinical need.

The report enables authorised users to analyse prescribing patterns by presentation type, cost, and volume across practices, SICBLs, and ICBs. It supports identification of trends, benchmarking against regional and national averages, and validation of claims for personally administered items. Users can filter data by time period and therapeutic category, making it a valuable tool for medicines optimisation and financial governance.

The aim of this report is to provide transparency in the prescribing and administration of injectable controlled drugs at presentation level. It helps organisations assess whether prescribing aligns with clinical guidance and funding arrangements, reducing unwarranted variation and improving patient outcomes. While the report offers detailed insights, it should be used alongside other dashboards and clinical data to inform decisions. Its intention is to support safe prescribing practices, promote accountability, and ensure efficient use of NHS resources.
